compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1: running pr-comment-response.sh against a test PR produces a normalized JSON file matching the schema {comment_id, root_comment_id, thread_url, body, author, is_inline, already_replied, defense_comment_id, path, position}
- DD2: root_comment_id for any reply comment is the true thread root (walked to null), terminates on malformed/circular references
- DD3: threads containing a reply beginning with <!-- dso-agent-reply --> are excluded from output
- DD4: script exits 0 and writes {"comments": [], "skipped_count": N} when no unresolved comments exist
- DD5: script exits non-zero with "ERROR: <message>" when the GitHub API call fails

## Implementation Notes
Create plugins/dso/scripts/pr-comment-response.sh:

### CLI Interface
```
pr-comment-response.sh --pr-number <N> --output <path> [--repo <owner/repo>]
```

### Startup Gates (run in order)
1. gh CLI version check: `gh --version` → extract semver → fail if < 2.0.0 with clear error
2. MCP probe: call probe_mcp_server from lib; set USE_MCP=true/false based on result

### Fetch Logic
- If USE_MCP=true: call GitHub MCP tool mcp__github__get_pull_request_comments (paginated)
- On any MCP failure (tool error, 401/403, timeout): fall back to gh api --paginate
- Fetch both review comments (GET /pulls/{n}/comments) and issue comments (GET /issues/{n}/comments)
- Handle rate-limit (HTTP 403/429 + retry-after): backoff and retry, max 3 attempts

### Normalization
For each comment:
- comment_id: comment.id
- root_comment_id: resolve via resolve_root_comment_id from lib (in_reply_to_id chain-walk)
- thread_url: comment.html_url
- body: comment.body
- author: comment.user.login
- is_inline: true if from review comments API, false if from issue comments API
- already_replied: true if any reply in same thread starts with "<!-- dso-agent-reply -->"
- defense_comment_id: null (set by defend handler in later stories)
- path: comment.path (inline only, null for top-level)
- position: comment.position (inline only, null for top-level)

### Deduplication / Filtering
- Exclude entire threads where already_replied=true (any reply begins with <!-- dso-agent-reply -->)
- skipped_count: number of threads excluded

### Output
- Write JSON {"comments": [...], "skipped_count": N} to --output path
- Empty case: {"comments": [], "skipped_count": N} — exit 0
- API failure: echo "ERROR: <message>" to stderr, exit non-zero

### Security
- GITHUB_TOKEN read from environment; never echo/print/log the token value

## Source lib
Source via: source "$_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/pr-comment-lib.sh" (or REPO_ROOT-relative path for worktree compatibility)

## Integration tests (already RED, must turn GREEN)
tests/integration/test-pr-comment-response-integration.sh exercises all 8 test cases including:
- test_fetch_produces_normalized_json_schema
- test_reply_in_thread_root_comment_id_resolved
- test_empty_pr_exits_0_and_writes_empty_json
- test_api_failure_exits_nonzero_with_error_prefix
- test_defend_comment_defense_comment_id_non_null (defense_comment_id starts null)
- test_defer_comment_ticket_id_in_json (ticket_id not set by this script, null OK)
- test_no_real_api_calls_escape
- test_all_three_comments_get_replies

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] plugins/dso/scripts/pr-comment-response.sh exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/pr-comment-response.sh
- [ ] Script accepts --pr-number and --output flags without error
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/pr-comment-response.sh --help 2>&1 | grep -qE "usage|pr-number|Usage" || true
- [ ] Script exits non-zero with "ERROR:" on API failure
  Verify: GH_EXIT_CODE=1 STUB_GH_SCENARIO=api_failure bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/pr-comment-response.sh --pr-number 42 --output /dev/null 2>&1 | grep -q "ERROR:" && false || true
- [ ] Integration tests pass (previously RED → GREEN)
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/integration/test-pr-comment-response-integration.sh
- [ ] .test-index entry confirmed for pr-comment-response.sh → integration test
  Verify: grep -q "plugins/dso/scripts/pr-comment-response.sh" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index
- [ ] GITHUB_TOKEN never emitted in any output path
  Verify: GITHUB_TOKEN=SECRET_CANARY bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/pr-comment-response.sh --pr-number 99 --output /dev/null 2>&1 | grep -v SECRET_CANARY || true

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
